fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-07-02, around 09:15, a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 12,00,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-07-03. The complaint was lodged by Sanjay Raj (9000000083). Rajesh Krishnan (9000000167) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The account reference SYN-ACC-100003 was noted in connection with the payment. The complainant alleged that Rakesh Gopal may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000405. Items referenced in the complaint: a bank transaction reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, receiving account, mobile number, shopping complex, witness, morning, suspect
